# 3R Oilfield Equipment

> 3R Oilfield Equipment is a fast-growing, internationally focused organisation
> creating a unified global circular-economy marketplace for surplus oil and gas
> equipment. Buy, sell and rent pre-owned, refurbished and surplus oilfield
> equipment — reducing cost, lead time and waste.

## About
3R servicing the global supply and demand of surplus oil and gas equipment. The
platform connects sellers (clearing idle/surplus assets), buyers (sourcing
verified pre-owned equipment fast and at lower cost) and partners (logistics,
inspection, refurbishment and ESG). It also operates the 3R Tool Pool — an
equipment-sharing platform for renting and leasing under-used tools between jobs.

## The 3 Rs
- Reduce: reduce waste by optimising the use of surplus equipment and materials more efficiently.
- Reuse: utilise used or unused equipment that can be refurbished and repurposed for new applications.
- Recycle: identify equipment, parts or materials that can be recycled to minimise waste.

## Browse by category
Live listings at https://3rmarketplace.com/#/browse — no sign-in required.
Each item has its own page with full specification, condition, quantity,
original manufacturer and documentation status. Categories:
- Subsea
- Capital Equipment
- Drilling
- Wells
- Platform
- Marine

Prices are shown where set; most items are POA (price on application) and are
quoted on enquiry. Listings come directly from 3R's own equipment register and
are maintained by 3R, not a third party.

## Process
List → Match → Verify (3R inspection & certification) → Transact → Deliver.

## Key facts
- $30B+ of oilfield equipment sits idle annually.
- ~70% of surplus is needlessly scrapped.
- Reuse carries roughly 4x lower carbon than buying new.
- Lead times cut from 5+ months to weeks.
